QuestInfo.0: Find #eUlrika#n and #eCutie#n near The Viking at the #b#m223030100##k.
QuestInfo.1: Ulrika said she would stop playing Hide-and-Seek if you got her some delicious Cotton Candy. Defeat #bBearic the White#k at #m223030100# and get #r2 Cotton Candies#k for her.
QuestInfo.2: Ulrika and Cutie looked so happy about the sweet treats!

0.0: Who are you? I don't talk to strangers, EVER. Don't say you know Elex just to trick me!\r\n#b(Ulrika and Cutie are whispering something to each other.)#k\r\n
0.1: Wait... maybe you could prove you're not too strange to be our pal. We're kinda hungry, and I don't want to walk around until I get something in my belly...

yes.0: I saw those Bearic the Whites eating yummy Cotton Candy. Bring back enough for the #rtwo of us#k, and I'll talk to you.

no.0: I didn't come all the way out here to have a bad time!

yes.0: Whoa, those look AWESOME! C'mon Cutie, let's go see Mr. Elex! \n\n

item.0: No Cotton Candy, no friends! Come on, how hard can Bearic the White be?
